lines.speaker: yan_s
lines.text: What are you doing?!

lines.speaker: yan_s
lines.text: Do you have any idea how expensive these are?

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: We all came here to have a fun time together, and you're hoarding all this delicious food just so you can make a few bucks?

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: How miserly can you get?

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: Just you wait; we're gonna whip up one heck of a feast with this stuff.

lines.speaker: neon_s
lines.text: A whole feast?

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: You betcha!

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: There's something I've had my eye on the moment we set foot on this island.

lines.speaker: yan_s
lines.text: Wait, my grill—!
Anis, excitable as always, begins to set everything up in a flurry.

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: I hereby declare this feast free!

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: Anis and Neon's firepower BBQ house is open for business!

lines.speaker: neon_s
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: I'll attract the customers, so you do the cooking, Neon.

lines.speaker: neon_s
lines.text: Me? Why?

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: Neon, in case you forgot,

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: you're the master of firepower.

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: If you want barbecue, then you need some flame to cook with, no? You're the perfect person for this job.

lines.speaker: neon_s
lines.text: It all makes sense now.

lines.speaker: neon_s
lines.text: Since this is a fire near the seaside...

lines.speaker: neon_s
lines.text: This is the perfect test for me to control both my firepower and waterpower!

lines.speaker: neon_s
lines.text: Bring in as many people as you can!

lines.speaker: neon_s
lines.text: I'm gonna serve up the most finger-lickin' BBQ they've ever tasted!

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: You got it!
*Sssssss*
*Sizzle sizzle*

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: Come and get it!

lines.speaker: yan_s
lines.text: My grill... all my precious food...

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: Stop whining and hurry up and eat it!

lines.speaker: yan_s
lines.text: Oh believe me, I wouldn't let any of this go to waste.

lines.speaker: yan_s
lines.text: *Chew*

lines.speaker: yan_s
lines.text: Wha...

lines.speaker: yan_s
lines.text: What have you done with this?

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: ... Is it that bad?

lines.speaker: yan_s
lines.text: It's delicious! Out of this world!

lines.speaker: yan_s
lines.text: Neon, what do you say we open up a restaurant when we're back in the Ark?

lines.speaker: neon_s
lines.text: Be quiet, would you?

lines.speaker: neon_s
lines.text: I've got to control the current temperature, humidity, and heat all at once.

lines.speaker: yan_s
lines.text: Oh, sorry...

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: Oh my goodness, some real food instead of Splendamin?

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: I'll take one with more vegetables.

lines.speaker: pepper_s
lines.text: Give me all the meat you can.

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: Okay, just a moment, please.

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: Our chef is working overtime back there.

lines.speaker: frima_s
lines.text: Smell. Amazing.

lines.speaker: frima_s
lines.text: Awake.

lines.speaker: liter_s
lines.text: Make one for Volt too.
The wafting smell of the enticing barbecue has attracted everyone who was previously spread out all over the island to gather in one spot.
All except for one.

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: It's quite something.

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: Not even this mouth-watering smell can make her come here?

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: Oh well, what can you do?

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: Neon.

lines.speaker: neon_s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: Give me three pieces of the finest grilled meat you can whip up.

lines.speaker: neon_s
lines.text: You're not going to eat it all, are you?

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: No!
Anis grabs a perfectly cooked piece of crispy golden-brown meat.

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: You take one as well, Commander.
Why me?

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: Everything tastes better when you eat together with other people.

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: Let's go!

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: We're gonna get Helm to taste this scrumdiddlyumptious barbecue.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: *Sigh*
*Koooo*

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: That vibration...

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Am I really the only one who can sense it?

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I just can't shake it from my mind. Something strange is g—

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: What are you mumbling?

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Gah!

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: What are you two doing here?

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: What is this?

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: You really couldn't smell this?

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: You must have really been concentrating on whatever it was.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I've been hearing a weird vibrating sound for a while, so I haven't been able to pay attention to anything else.

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: Really? Is everything okay?

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Yeah, I think I'll be okay if I rest a bit.

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: You think so?

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: Well, in that case, chomp on this while you rest.
It's a skewer that Neon made.

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: Ahem, that Neon and I made.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Thanks.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Where did you get this, anyway?

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: You ask too many questions.

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: Just take a bite.

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: The flavor is second to none.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: *Chew*

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: Well? Isn't it great?!

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: ... Yeah.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: It's nice.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I've never had something that tasted like this before.

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: Helm, are you thinking about Mast and Anchor right now?

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: If only they were here. They would enjoy this more than anyone.

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: Stuff like that?

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: I knew it.

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: I told you to loosen up.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: ... But I can't help it.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: This was our first mission associated with the sea.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: So it all weighs on me a bit differently.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Us coming here has turned up nothing of substance,

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: yet everyone seems to be enjoying themselves.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I keep thinking how much Mast and Anchor would be enjoying themselves as well if they were here...

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: It is a bit peculiar, I suppose.

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: The signal apparently picked up something massive.

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: If it were so colossal though, surely you would have been able to see it when you went diving?

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: You're right.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I didn't discover anything.

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: But how could that be?

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: ... What if the signal moved?

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: That... would be a cause for concern.

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: Is there a way to find out?

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: We need a locating device out in the water.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: One that can track signal locations in real time.

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: But there's no way we'll be able to find something like that here.
We can make one ourselves.
Let's ask Liter for help.

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: What? Are you going senile or something?

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text:
We're not Mighty Tools.
How could we possibly make it ourselves?

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: Oh, right!

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: I totally forgot Liter is here.

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: Let's go and ask her.

lines.speaker: liter_s
lines.text: *Chew chew*

lines.speaker: liter_s
lines.text: A tracking device that you put in the water, which can track objects in real time...

lines.speaker: liter_s
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: liter_s
lines.text: It's doable, but there's one specific material that's absolutely mandatory,

lines.speaker: liter_s
lines.text: and I don't think you'll be able to find it here.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: liter_s
lines.text: A GPS receiver.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Oh...
Do you think we could find one somewhere else on the island?

lines.speaker: yan_s
lines.text: Give me another.

lines.speaker: neon_s
lines.text: Here you go.

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: One more for me, as well.

lines.speaker: neon_s
lines.text: Coming right up.

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: I never thought she'd become a barbecue baron in such a short period.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: No.
What?

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: We've got plenty of GPS receivers all around us.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Everyone brought their cellphones with them, didn't they?

lines.speaker: liter_s
lines.text: Ah!

lines.speaker: liter_s
lines.text: Good thinking.

lines.speaker: liter_s
lines.text: Most cellphones come with a built-in GPS receiver.

lines.speaker: pepper_s
lines.text: Of course I brought it.

lines.speaker: pepper_s
lines.text: But what's all this about a GPS receiver?

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: We're planning on making a tracking device that can track objects in real time,

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: and we need a GPS receiver in order to build it.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: So, we're going to have to take apart one of our phones.

lines.speaker: rapi_s
lines.text: I thought the mission was over.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: There's been some suspicious activity, so the mission has been resumed.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Your cooperation in this matter would be greatly appreciated.

lines.speaker: rapi_s
lines.text: Very well, you can use my cellphone, then.

lines.speaker: liter_s
lines.text: No, there's no need.

lines.speaker: liter_s
lines.text: We need to use the cellphone that has the best GPS inside.

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: How come?

lines.speaker: liter_s
lines.text: If we were placing this device on the mainland, it wouldn't be a problem, but this is an island.

lines.speaker: liter_s
lines.text: Just to play it safe, it'd be wise to construct it using only the best materials.

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: But I just got this phone...

lines.speaker: liter_s
lines.text: Okay everyone, hand over your phones.

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: You're actually serious, aren't you?

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: Has no one else gotten a new phone recently?

lines.speaker: mary_s
lines.text: I don't care much when it comes to my cell phone. I'm more concerned with having the most up-to-date medical equipment.

lines.speaker: pepper_s
lines.text: Mine is quite new, but it's a few generations behind yours, Anis.

lines.speaker: neon_s
lines.text: Phones are way too expensive these days for me to upgrade.

lines.speaker: pepper_s
lines.text: I know! It feels like there's a new one every time you turn around, and they're all so expensive.

lines.speaker: yan_s
lines.text: You must have deep pockets to afford a new phone.

lines.speaker: frima_s
lines.text: Zzzzz...

lines.speaker: rapi_s
lines.text: It's decided then.

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: You've gotta be kidding me.

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: Is it really going to be me?

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: I've barely had this phone for a year!

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: I was gonna use it to take photos here and play games before going to sleep.
I'll buy you a new one once we're back.
I'll take plenty of nice photos for you with my phone.

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: All right, you promised! Don't you forget that!

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: My data won't be erased or anything, will it?

lines.speaker: liter_s
lines.text: No, it'll be fine.

lines.speaker: liter_s
lines.text: I'll be dismantling it, but I'll keep all the parts intact.
I feel like I've been duped... whatever, let's just get this over with.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: I know this is all rather sudden, but thank you for understanding.

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: What else can I do? It's required for the mission.

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: But! I'll only do it on one condition.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: And that is?

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: You've gotta hang around and have fun with us until the device is complete.

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: You won't have anything to do until then anyway.

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: I know you feel bad coming here by yourself.

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: But we're all concerned for you if you continue to stay in this funk.

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: So, are you going to hang out with us, or not?

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: Yes!

lines.speaker: liter_s
lines.text: I'll get to work on the device straight away.

lines.speaker: liter_s
lines.text: If everything goes smoothly, then it'll be ready tonight. If not, it'll be done by mid-day tomorrow.
Thanks, Liter.
